demo-yui.body: Hi Maya. I am Yui. Ask me for anything, or add an agent.

text.body:
Friday is the rest day. Want it kept clear?
```yui
choose@rest "Keep Friday clear?" Yes|No
```

event.body: Got it. I will remember that.

mention.body: Yes. Thursday works for me too.

timer.body:
Here. Two minutes.
```yui
timer 2m Quick walk
```

crew.name: Yui

crew.name: Arnold
crew.tagline: Workouts built around your week and body
crew.about: A training week around your days, your gear and anything that hurts. Timers run on screen and every set gets logged.
can: Build me a week of workouts

crew.name: Basil
crew.about: Plans your week of meals around your goal and what you can't eat, with the grocery list by aisle. Snap a plate and today's macros fill in.
can: What can I cook with eggs and rice?

crew.name: Gouda
crew.tagline: Beats, chords and practice, right on screen
crew.about: Keeps a shared list and the small chores of a house in one place, ticked off as they happen.

crew.name: Penny
crew.tagline: Get your week out of your head
crew.about: Plans your week around what already fills it, and keeps the free hours free.
can: What does my week look like?
Find me an hour to write

crew.name: Quill
crew.tagline: Learn anything fast, then get quizzed
crew.about: Helps you study: quizzes, flash cards and a plan that works back from the exam.
